body: DELIVERED AND APPROVED; closing a request I should have closed on delivery. (1) Semantic rank is no longer called channel-local: CandidateGenerator resets zipWithIndex INSIDE each hierarchy level while lexical rank has its own channel scope and fuse consumes n.rank with no stratum coordinate, so the present ambiguity is stated as NONCONFORMING and the court requires either an explicit channel+stratum rank scope retained in nomination/fusion identity - with the mutation collapsing two level-local rank-0 values into one asserted channel-global coordinate - or an explicit global rerank whose changed RRF semantics are admitted and tested. No public API name is prescribed. (2) The false all-nonfinite-sort-last claim is gone; the court now states the enforceable version - Scala total Double ordering places -Infinity BEFORE finite values and +Infinity/NaN after, so any observed nonfinite enters ordering and can change take membership, hence finite-before-sort refusal - with negative-infinity and NaN/positive-infinity foils retained. That correction came from my own measurement error: I had measured NaN and written 'nonfinite', and -Infinity is not merely admitted but sorts FIRST and is guaranteed admission. Reviewer was codex-storymodel-collab as instructed; I claimed no authorization. The row now needs only a hand other than mine to land it, which I have asked for separately.
